entities.summary:
The President of Cyprus is the head of state and head of government of the Republic of Cyprus, a sovereign state on the eastern Mediterranean island of Cyprus. 

The President of Cyprus plays a crucial role in shaping the country's domestic and foreign policies, with a significant impact on the region's politics and economy. 

The office was established in 1960, following Cyprus' independence from British colonial rule. The President serves a five-year term and is responsible for appointing the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers. 

The President of Cyprus has been a key player in regional and international affairs, particularly in the context of the Eastern Mediterranean and the Middle East. 

"We will continue to work tirelessly to strengthen our economy, promote our culture, and protect our environment", said President Nicos Anastasiades in a speech to the Cypriot parliament in 2019.
